title: 第317章 破阵第316章 兵俑如潮
content_zh:
徐长生和徐念一前一后，射入青铜门内的幽暗之中。
方才被引出去的那几波兵佣，在这片阵列中留下了几处突兀的空缺，像是棋盘上被吃掉了几枚棋子。
徐念在前领路，身形灵活地绕过一尊尊兵佣。
徐长生紧随其后。
在他们踏足之后。
其余兵佣瞬间被惊醒，一个个爆发出森寒的杀气。
虽然早有预料，可是，当真的直面这些兵佣时，徐长生仍旧忍不住心头一颤。
“嗖”
一支羽箭朝徐长生面门激射而来。
徐长生手中游龙剑一挥，将羽箭挡开。
但是，早有四名手持长戈的兵佣，拦在了徐长生前方。
“轰”
长戈撕裂虚空，朝徐长生头顶重重砸下。
徐长生瞳孔微缩，脚尖在地上一点，身如鸿羽，从兵佣头顶上空掠过。
徐念从一旁冲来，从背后用力推了一把徐长生。
徐长生再一具兵佣头顶借力一踩，整个人飘然落到了祭坛前方，三丈之处。
身后，无数兵佣沉默着涌了上来。
兵刃碰撞，发出沉闷的呜咽。
祭坛四角的青铜兽首，口中衔着的暗金色锁链，深深没入地面石板之中，如同一头巨兽的四只利爪钉入大地。
祭坛上方的符文明灭不定，那方大秦玉玺静静放置在坛顶，散发着沉厚而威严的气息。

而祭坛四角，果然立着四尊比其他兵佣高出一头的将军俑，各自手持长剑，面朝四方，如同四尊沉默的守卫。
其他兵佣都在追杀徐长生和徐念，唯有这四尊兵佣，一动不动。
“四尊阵眼各守一方，中心祭坛的玉玺既是最显眼的宝物，也是最危险的饵。”
“如果贸然去取玉玺，四尊将军俑必然同时苏醒，到时候被围在中间的人，想跑都跑不了。”
徐长生心中闪过这个念头，扫了一眼玉玺之后，将目光投向四具将军俑。
与此同时，身后的兵佣已经冲到了近前。
数把长戈同时砸下，封锁了徐长生的四面八方。
游龙剑在手中猛然一转，一道青白色的剑芒以他为中心向四周扩散开来，如同一圈无声的水波掠过头顶。
"叮叮叮叮"
那几柄长戈同时被剑芒震得向侧方荡开，持戈的兵佣各自后退了半步。
但更多的兵佣已经填补了空缺，一尊接一尊地从后方涌来，如同被惊动的蚁群，密密麻麻地铺满了整片视野。
徐念从侧方冲了过来，他浑身沾满了尘土，嘴角的血痕还没干透。
"主人，我拖住它们！你去破阵！"
话音未落，徐念已经如同一枚出膛的石弹般撞入兵佣群中，他双手化爪，每一爪都挠向兵佣的眼部。
虽然他的力量远不如徐影那三具傀儡尸，但胜在身形灵活，在密集的阵列中如同一条滑溜的泥鳅，搅得那些兵佣的动作出现了一片短暂的混乱。
徐长生借着这片混乱的空隙，身形猛然拔高，如同一只展翅的鹰隼掠向祭坛方向。
脚下的兵佣们纷纷抬头，有弓弩手举起了手中的弩臂，箭矢如同密集的雨点般向他射来。
游龙剑在身前划出一道圆弧，剑光如同一面青白色的圆盾，将射来的箭矢尽数弹开。
他落地时，已经跳到了祭坛上。
只要伸出手，就能取走玉玺！

就在这一瞬间，徐长生感觉到一股无形的压迫感正在祭坛四周凝聚，仿佛有一只无形的手正在缓缓收紧，将周围的空气一点点抽走。
他没有去碰那方玉玺，而是将目光落在了那一道道锁链上。
content_en:
Xu Changsheng and Xu Nian shot into the darkness inside the bronze door one after the other.
The waves of mercenaries that had just been led out left several abrupt gaps in the array, like a few chess pieces that had been eaten on a chessboard.
Xu Nian led the way, nimbly bypassing a military mercenary.
Xu Changsheng followed closely behind.
After they set foot.
The other mercenaries were instantly awakened, and each of them burst out with cold murderous intent.
Although he had expected it, when he actually faced these mercenaries, Xu Changsheng still couldn't help but feel his heart tremble.
"Whoosh"
A feather arrow shot towards Xu Changsheng's face.
Xu Changsheng waved the mid-range dragon sword in his hand to deflect the arrow.
However, four mercenaries armed with long swords had already blocked Xu Changsheng's path.
"Boom"
Chang Ge tore through the void and hit Xu Changsheng's head heavily.
Xu Changsheng's pupils shrank slightly, his toes were slightly on the ground, and his body was like a feather, passing over the heads of the mercenaries.
Xu Nian rushed from the side and pushed Xu Changsheng hard from behind.
Xu Changsheng stepped on another soldier's head and landed three feet in front of the altar.
Behind him, countless soldiers and mercenaries rushed up silently.
The weapons collided and let out a dull whimper.
The bronze animal heads at the four corners of the altar, and the dark golden chains held in the mouth, were deeply embedded in the stone slabs on the ground, like the four sharp claws of a giant beast nailed into the earth.
The symbols above the altar are uncertain. The Great Qin Jade Seal is placed quietly on the top of the altar, exuding a deep and majestic aura.
As expected, at the four corners of the altar stood four statues of generals that were a head taller than the other soldiers and mercenaries, each holding a long sword and facing all directions, like four silent guards.
The other mercenaries were chasing Xu Changsheng and Xu Nian, but these four mercenaries remained motionless.
"The four formation eyes each guard one side. The jade seal on the central altar is both the most conspicuous treasure and the most dangerous bait."
"If you rush to get the jade seal, the four generals will wake up at the same time, and the people surrounded by them will not be able to escape even if they want to."
This thought flashed through Xu Changsheng's mind. After glancing at the jade seal, he turned his attention to the four general figurines.
At the same time, the mercenaries behind him had already rushed forward.
Several Changges were smashed down at the same time, blocking all sides of Xu Changsheng.
The Youlong Sword suddenly turned in his hand, and a blue-white sword light spread out in all directions with him as the center, like a silent water wave passing over his head.
"ding ding ding ding"
The long swords were shaken sideways by the sword light at the same time, and the mercenaries holding the swords each took half a step back.
But more mercenaries have filled the vacancy, one after another coming from behind, like a colony of disturbed ants, densely covering the entire field of vision.
Xu Nian rushed over from the side. His whole body was covered with dust, and the blood stains on the corners of his mouth had not yet dried.
"Master, I'll hold them back! You go and break the formation!"
Before he finished speaking, Xu Nian had already crashed into the group of mercenaries like a stone bullet. His hands turned into claws, and each claw scratched the mercenaries' eyes.
Although his strength was far inferior to Xu Ying's three puppet corpses, he was more flexible than him. He was like a slippery loach in the dense array, causing a brief chaos in the movements of the mercenaries.
Xu Changsheng took advantage of this chaotic gap to suddenly rise up, like an eagle with spread wings, flying toward the altar.
The soldiers and mercenaries at his feet raised their heads one after another. A crossbowman raised his crossbow arm, and arrows shot towards him like dense raindrops.
The Youlong Sword drew an arc in front of him, and the light of the sword was like a blue-white round shield, deflecting all the incoming arrows.
When he landed, he had jumped onto the altar.
As long as you stretch out your hand, you can take away the jade seal!
At this moment, Xu Changsheng felt an invisible sense of oppression gathering around the altar, as if an invisible hand was slowly tightening, sucking away the surrounding air bit by bit.
He did not touch Fang Yuxi, but focused his gaze onOn those chains.
